name: mizan-firestore-rules-check
description: Runs firestore.rules against the local Firestore emulator (needs Java). Not part of npm test.

scripts.test: cp ../../firestore.rules firestore.rules && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-mizan "node --test rules.test.js"
scripts.e2e: cp ../../firestore.rules firestore.rules && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-mizan "node --test ../../tests/friends-e2e.test.js"
